programme.title: Troublesome
programme.desc: Veteran homicide detective Michael reluctantly partners with rookie Derrick. Witnessing a double homicide, they survive a deadly chase, but Derrick is wounded. The suspects are linked to the kingpin, who retaliates by ordering murders across the city. As chaos erupts, the FBI joins the case, revealing the kingpin's identity. Michael finds a weak link, offering a chance to finally catch him.

programme.title: Saints 2 Aints
programme.desc: Stuck in a loveless marriage, Chiffona pines for her first love Orvalle and laments to her girlfriends, but plans on moving to a new town to try and save her marriage. Her friend Gevia says she has found love, but keeps his identity a secret. After time passes, a now single Chiffona, moves back to town and learns Gevia's mystery man is none other than Orvalle.

programme.title: Sex and the Single Lady 2
programme.desc: Tamia, Kai, Petra and Ebony are faced with challenges that put their friendship to the test, when the ties that once bonded them are broken.

programme.title: She Time
programme.desc: Krystal, a devoted wife and mother, finds herself trapped in the routine of a her daily life and a fading marriage. Longing for excitement and passion, she embarks on a girls’ night out that unexpectedly reignites an old flame from her past.

programme.title: Revisiting the Heart
programme.desc: Azia Steed is a lead homicide detective who handles a heavy caseload while juggling her personal life. After taking some time off, she runs into an old fling, Dr. Ezrah Jacobs III. Azia receives a case involving the murder of a known local basketball star. The more evidence is uncovered, the stronger the web of deception becomes.

programme.title: Christmas Family Ties
programme.desc: Two years after the death of her mother, Amaya pleads to Santa to bring her family together for Christmas like they used to. Her father David, having fallen out with his siblings after his own mother’s death, decides to bring her to their ancestral family home for the holiday. Will they survive the holiday with their own family dysfunction and financial ruin hanging over their heads?

programme.title: Festive Fling
programme.desc: After Shelly’s painful divorce, she was left feeling like the black sheep of the family. Desperate to move on from the pain of her past, she invites her co-worker Greg to visit her family to pretend to be her boyfriend to deflect her family’s unwanted comments. Little did she know, that her holiday fling, would become a holiday thing.

programme.title: Love and Leftovers
programme.desc: Jacob is a successful chef with big dreams of opening his own restaurant, but struggles in his personal life due to his demanding girlfriend, Drina. When Lisa, a strong-willed and grounded woman comes along and sees his potential, Jacob finds himself torn between something familiar, or something new.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Roast 2
programme.desc: Single and work-obsessed, Mya, reluctantly visits her family in North Carolina she has not seen in years, after her friend Jasmine insists. To avoid the discomforting pressure her family puts on her to get married, she hires a man to join her and play her boyfriend. Chaos ensues as soon as they arrive to meet Mya's over the top family. A wild Thanksgiving holiday is in store for all when Mya's charade does not go as planned.

programme.title: Thanksgiving With The Carters
programme.desc: A family tries to find common ground with its newest members, as they honor their tradition of Thanksgiving surprise, where each person attempts to surprise the family with something unique and positive.

programme.title: Family Thanksgiving
programme.desc: When returning home for Thanksgiving, Elliot, tries to keep cool with his meddlesome, dysfunctional family.

programme.title: Thanksgiving with the Carters: 2nd Helping
programme.desc: The Carter family is back together again for the Thanksgiving holiday, and this time they are celebrating at a cabin deep in the woods. When chaos ensues and dinner is ruined, the family must work together to save the holiday tradition.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Roast
programme.desc: Preston must win over Madison's crazy family over Thanksgiving, in the hopes to obtain her hand in marriage.

programme.title: Giving Thanks
programme.desc: A widowed mother reunites her family for Thanksgiving, but secrets will be revealed and family bonds will be tested. As the saying goes, you can't pick your family, but be thankful for what you have no matter what.

programme.title: Murder Gardens 2
programme.desc: After serving 10 years in prison, Chase returns to Miami Gardens with a goal of reclaiming his life. But the criminal empire that he was once part of has changed and his older brother Rell is now one of the heads in charge. He recruits Chase for one last job, but things are about to spiral out of control.
